_meta.notes: Agency products, not press coverage — the news view keeps them in their own strip. Every item carries the date its agency published it, parsed from the page; an undated item is dropped rather than stamped with the collection time. Items past their cadence are flagged stale rather than hidden. NOAA Climate.gov's ENSO blog is probed every run and deliberately excluded: it returns 200 with a fresh Last-Modified while its newest post is more than a year old.

bulletins.title: Weekly relative Niño 3.4 +2.64 °C (week to 15 Nov), Troup SOI -7.1 (30 days to 19 Nov)
bulletins.summary: BoM's operational ocean index for the week ending 15 November 2026. Its El Niño threshold is +0.8 °C, higher than CPC's +0.5. The SOI is negative, the El Niño-like sign, so the atmosphere is coupled to the ocean signal.

bulletins.title: Comunicado Oficial ENFEN N° 20-2026
bulletins.summary: Peru's multisectoral ENSO committee; the communiqué sets the coastal El Niño alert level. Coastal Peru is where an east-weighted event lands first.

bulletins.title: ENSO Alert System Status: El Niño Advisory
bulletins.summary: El Niño continues to strengthen, with a strong-to-very strong El Niño likely through January-March 2027 (remaining greater than a 79% chance). Compared to last month, El Niño strengthened as sea surface temperature anomalies exceeded 4. The monthly ENSO Diagnostic Discussion, issued on the second Thursday.
